issues: Page 2 of the PDF is blank (form feed only); the cover/title is page 1 and the copyright page begins on page 3.
Printed page numbers are offset from PDF page indices (e.g. PDF page 4 carries printed footer '2'); this outline uses the <<<PAGE n>>> PDF index, never printed page numbers.

The Table of Contents is duplicated in the extraction: TOC entries occupy PDF pages 4-24, then the same headings reappear as body headings from page 24 onward. Headings were disambiguated by line position.
Some heading text loses the space after the number (e.g. '1.1International Classification of Diseases'), and several long headings wrap across two lines (e.g. 2.10.1, 2.18, 2.19.4.4, 3.14.9).
Annex C (3.14) and Annex E (3.16) contain long enumerated lists/tables (ill-defined conditions, value-set cross-references) whose extracted order is not always linear across page breaks.
The document ends on page 473 mid-list (the verbal-autopsy target list of causes of death); there is no index or other back-matter after Annex E.

Front-matter boundaries fall on transitional pages that carry two sections at once: page 4 mixes the copyright/disclaimer tail with the start of the TOC, page 24 mixes the TOC tail with the start of '0.2 How to use', page 25 mixes the acronym table with the start of the Glossary, and page 28 carries the Glossary's final definition before Part 1 begins. Each transitional page is attributed to the section whose content dominates it.
Body headings are sometimes indented (leading whitespace) while the TOC copies are flush-left; naive line-start matching treats the two copies differently.
